what.text: This page follows refugees from Côte d'Ivoire living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 22950 Ivorian refugees in France, 70.6% of all refugees from Côte d'Ivoire.
France is the largest host of Ivorian refugees, followed by Italy, Germany and Liberia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ivory Coast from 2002 to 2004, with the MPCI, MPIGO, MJP and FRCI.
It records armed conflict again in 2011, with FDSI-CI and FRCI.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 19 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
